customDescriptions.value: Apply trained deep neural networks to audio signals for tasks like speech enhancement, source separation, or sound classification — use when data-driven audio processing outperforms classical algorithms
Access demonstration models and examples showcasing Audio Toolbox capabilities — use as starting points or reference implementations for audio processing workflows
Apply compression, expansion, limiting, or gating to control audio signal amplitude — use to prevent clipping, reduce dynamic range for broadcast, or shape transient response
Apply audio effects such as reverb, chorus, flanger, distortion, or delay — use for creative sound design or modeling audio processing chains in real-time applications
Extract audio features like MFCCs, spectral centroid, pitch, or zero-crossing rate — use for audio analysis, speech recognition preprocessing, or music information retrieval
Design and apply audio filters including parametric EQ, crossovers, shelving, and octave-band filters — use for frequency-selective processing in audio systems
Display Audio Toolbox version and configuration information — use to verify toolbox installation and compatibility
Measure audio signal properties like loudness (LUFS), THD, SNR, or frequency response — use for audio quality assessment and standards compliance testing
Output audio to speakers, files, or audio devices — use as the final stage in an audio processing pipeline to play back or record processed signals
Generate or acquire audio from microphones, files, oscillators, or noise generators — use as input to audio processing pipelines for real-time capture or offline analysis
Embed custom MATLAB functions or System objects into the audio processing stream — use when built-in blocks do not cover your specific audio algorithm
